fields.name: Result-set list property
fields.definition: A settable `List<Model>` or `IList<Model>` property of a model that the Mapper fills from an additional data-reader result set, expressing a one-to-many relationship (an order and its items). No attribute is needed: the generic arguments of a MapReader or MapOutput call give the expected order of result sets, and each set is assigned to the property whose element type matches. A model therefore cannot have two list properties of the same element type. Lists inside listed models are not populated.
